nextStoryContext: US-R1-003 fixed the CRITICAL missing CAM_WORKER=1 marker in the headless child env: stripHeadlessChildEnv (src/supervisor/headless-argv.ts, the SAME file US-R1-001/002 already touched for --agent/--permission-mode) previously only deleted keys (WORKER_ENV_UNSET, HOST_ONLY_ENV_UNSET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and never SET CAM_WORKER=1 (WORKER_ACTOR_ENV, backend-adapter.ts), even though the headless child inherits CAM_SESSION from the sidecar unchanged. .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh's worker-actor write-guard on scripts/cam/prd.json / scripts/cam/issues/* (ADR-0035, CAM-63/CAM-166) uses CAM_WORKER as the SOLE discriminator gated only by CAM_SESSION, so a headless worker could previously self-flip passes:true undetected. Fix: `env.CAM_WORKER = '1'` set as a direct literal at the end of stripHeadlessChildEnv, mirroring the container path's literal '-e CAM_WORKER=1' (worker-container.ts's buildDockerRunArgv) rather than destructuring the shell-fragment constant WORKER_ACTOR_ENV ('CAM_WORKER=1', meant for shell-string concatenation, not key/value parsing). One new regression test pins env.CAM_WORKER === '1' unconditionally (no sourceEnv input controls it). No argv/flag change this time -- this was purely an env-side gap in the SAME 'mirror ALL of contract X' class US-R1-001 (missing --agent) and US-R1-002 (missing --permission-mode) already found, generalized here to the env side of the mirrored contract rather than its argv flags (see patterns.md). Next implementer picking up a US-R1-* story from this round-1 review batch: prd.json still carries US-R1-004 (README staleness), US-R1-005 (headless ignoring implBackend, loop.ts's same dispatch branch touched by US-R1-002/003's threading), and a sixth round-1 finding, all passes:false -- see openQuestions. Given the pattern of THREE consecutive US-R1-* findings all landing in headless-argv.ts's mirror-gap (--agent, --permission-mode, CAM_WORKER env), it may be worth a full audit of every remaining tmux-contract env var (workerEnvPrefix's -u list, any other backend-adapter.ts-exported marker) against headless-argv.ts before assuming no fourth gap remains in this same file.
